score: A - lambda*C; raw full-team mean logistic viability including focal player
selection: exact highest K scores; ties ascending athlete_id; nearest integer with halves up
standardization: within each frozen season; population standard deviation; fixed across assignments
seed_rule: SeedSequence([master_seed, season, repetition_index_0_based]); PCG64 default_rng; shared permutation and uniforms per pair
fallback: 2014/2016: omit both points and minutes for partial point/minute pairs or positive points with zero minutes; retain game for coverage; user approved
canonical_team: most distinct positive-minute games after fallback, then total minutes; unresolved played-team tie stops
population_2015: accepted rotation audit freeze with recorded source recoveries; verify existing hash
scope: three separate season populations, simulated selections of all eligible players; not last-ps HERO or annual draft prediction
curve: 16 equal-count LOO bins fixed per assignment across lambda; no quadratic fit or formal significance test
